tool_input.command: for f in README.md index.html package.json pigment.app.json playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done

$p = Get-Content package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $p.dependencies | Add-Member -NotePropertyName '@fontsource-variable/inter' -NotePropertyValue '^5.2.0' -Force; $p.dependencies | Add-Member -NotePropertyName '@fontsource/geist-mono' -NotePropertyValue '^5.2.0' -Force; $p | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content package.json; Get-Content package.json
tool_input.description: Add self-hosted font packages to dependencies

tool_input.command: npm install; Get-ChildItem node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/files -Filter *latin* | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; Get-ChildItem node_modules/@fontsource/geist-mono/files -Filter *400-normal.woff2 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name
tool_input.description: Install fonts and list their font files
